title: Cara S NDE 5139
content: I felt the presence of my dead father in the theatre room when I realized that the anesthetic was not working on me. He was in the corner, trying to comfort me in the unbelievable pain that I was in from the surgery that I was going through, since I was feeling everything that the surgeon was doing to me. He was telling me that it would be over very soon. When the surgeon had finished, and they were taking the tubes out of me and asking me my name, the only thing I said with my last breath was 'The anesthetic did not work, I felt everything.' I stopped breathing. My father came up closer to me holding my hand. I felt slight movement in my legs, and started kicking to signal something was wrong to the surgeon. I stopped breathing. It felt like several minutes had passed when the surgeon realized something was wrong. I was too weak to kick and stopped. They were losing me. The surgeon checked to see my heart beat, very weak, and realized that I had stopped breathing. I heard a nurse say they were losing me. I then felt my father taking me by the hand and my spirit rising from my body as I could see nurses and surgeon working on my body. I saw a tunnel and bright lights, and felt the presence of other dead people going towards the light through the tunnel. Then as I was getting nearer to the light I was stopped, and my father asked if I wanted to continue, but there would be no return to earth. I said no, I had to get back to my sons. Then I can't explain at what speed it was I went back into my body, like being electrocuted, and took a breath. I opened my eyes and saw the surgeon collapse next to me crying.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt her father taking her by the hand and her spirit rising from her body.

arrival.other_being_detail: Presence of other dead people going towards the light through the tunnel.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned to the body 'like being electrocuted' and then took a breath.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Felt severe pain because the anesthetic did not work; perceived deceased father present before the OBE.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Deceased father was perceived in the operating room before the out-of-body separation; then OBE with view of medical staff, then tunnel/light with other dead people, then boundary/choice, then return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived deceased father present and comforting her in the operating room while still in the body and in pain from surgery/anesthetic failure.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'The anesthetic did not work, I felt everything.'; 'like being electrocuted'
